C1541.title: Resolv Protocol Hack
C1541.summary: An attacker exploited a critical flaw in the USR minting function of the Resolv protocol, manipulating the oracle with only about $100,000 USDC to mint unauthorized tokens and disrupt the protocol's economic balance.
